edit.description: isSubject routes a slashless span to the identifier arm alone; share the filename detection isPathSubject already performs
fixture case for the fenced hyphenated page name; EXTERNAL_VOCABULARY for the layout names the widened rule surfaces

summary: Share the path arm's filename detection with the backticked arm: a fenced slashless page name is judged by nothing today

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: The scan judges a fenced page name the identifier charset refuses, and the repo pin stays green with every span it newly surfaces repaired to a repo-relative path or named in EXTERNAL_VOCABULARY.
tests: the citation scan judges a backticked page name whose spelling carries a hyphen
pins: the citation scan judges no backticked member access spelled with a leading dot
notes: isSubject reaches isPathSubject only on a slash, so a slashless span falls to SEGMENT, which refuses `-`. 22 fenced cites in src/ are judged by nothing: `engine-boundary.md` x14, `platform-facts.md`, `tick-verdicts.jsonl`, `package-lock.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `.element.shape`. src/git.ts:40 dangles unjudged while src/git.ts:49 cites the sibling page as a path and is judged. `.element.shape` (src/PendingSchema.ts:208) must stay refused — hence the pin.
